question.text: Per the chapter, when is NAV typically computed on a DAILY basis (as distinct from the minimum monthly disclosure for open-ended Cat III funds)?

answer.text: When the Cat III AIF is investing only in listed securities
When the fund has less than INR 100 crore AUM

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'In case a Category III AIF is investing in listed securities only, NAV is usually computed on a daily basis.' The workbook also notes that NAV declaration can be daily, monthly or quarterly as specified in the PPM. The Trap: AUM size is not a valuation-frequency trigger; year-end-only conflicts with the periodic disclosure rule; sponsor direction does not override the PPM/regulatory frequency. Note: Daily NAV is tied to the nature of the holdings (only listed securities), not to fund size or sponsor preference.
